verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted API, so account and data portability is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never documents any way to export a user's stored data, such as account details, usage history or cached content. Its open output formats (Markdown, JSON) and the self-hostable open-source image are the product's core conversion function and a deployment option, not a data export capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
